question: Welche Kundenkonten haben ihren Monatsumsatz vom ersten zum letzten aktiven Monat am staerksten gesteigert (mindestens 5 Bestellungen insgesamt)?
generated_sql:
WITH MonthlyRevenue AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS month,
        SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS revenue
    FROM 
        public.orders o
    JOIN 
        public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
    GROUP BY 
        o.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)
),
FirstLastMonthRevenue AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(month) AS first_month,
        MAX(month) AS last_month
    FROM 
        MonthlyRevenue
    GROUP BY 
        customer_id
),
CustomerGrowth AS (
    SELECT 
        m.customer_id,
        f.first_month,
        f.last_month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.month = f.first_month THEN m.revenue ELSE 0 END) AS first_month_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.month = f.last_month THEN m.revenue ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.month) AS active_months
    FROM 
        MonthlyRevenue m
    JOIN 
        FirstLastMonthRevenue f ON m.customer_id = f.customer_id
    GROUP BY 
        m.customer_id, f.first_month, f.last_month
)
SELECT 
    c.customer_id, 
    cu.company_name,
    first_month_revenue, 
    last_month_revenue, 
    last_month_revenue - first_month_revenue AS revenue_growth
FROM 
    CustomerGrowth c
JOIN 
    public.customers cu ON c.customer_id = cu.customer_id
WHERE 
    active_months >= 5
ORDER BY 
    revenue_growth DESC
LIMIT 5;
response_preview:

question: Welche Produktpaare aus unterschiedlichen Kategorien werden ueberproportional oft gemeinsam gekauft (Lift gegenueber Unabhaengigkeit)?
generated_sql:
WITH product_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        od1.product_id AS product_id1, 
        od2.product_id AS product_id2, 
        COUNT(*) AS pair_count
    FROM 
        public.order_details od1
    JOIN 
        public.order_details od2 ON od1.order_id = od2.order_id AND od1.product_id < od2.product_id
    JOIN 
        public.products p1 ON od1.product_id = p1.product_id
    JOIN 
        public.products p2 ON od2.product_id = p2.product_id
    WHERE 
        p1.category_id <> p2.category_id
    GROUP BY 
        od1.product_id, od2.product_id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM 
        public.order_details
    GROUP BY 
        product_id
),
lift_calculation AS (
    SELECT 
        pp.product_id1, 
        pp.product_id2, 
        pp.pair_count, 
        pt1.total_count AS total_count1, 
        pt2.total_count AS total_count2,
        (pp.pair_count::float / (pt1.total_count * pt2.total_count)) AS lift
    FROM 
        product_pairs pp
    JOIN 
        product_totals pt1 ON pp.product_id1 = pt1.product_id
    JOIN 
        product_totals pt2 ON pp.product_id2 = pt2.product_id
)
SELECT 
    p1.product_name AS product_name1, 
    p2.product_name AS product_name2, 
    lc.lift
FROM 
    lift_calculation lc
JOIN 
    public.products p1 ON lc.product_id1 = p1.product_id
JOIN 
    public.products p2 ON lc.product_id2 = p2.product_id
ORDER BY 
    lc.lift DESC
LIMIT 10;

FROM public.orders o

GROUP BY s.company_name
ORDER BY delay_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
